title: Cybersecurity — Beginner to Advanced — Intermediate Practical Assessment
instructions: This is a course-specific, intermediate practical assessment for Cybersecurity — Beginner to Advanced. Submit the requested code, query, configuration, or operational artifact as text. The backend applies deterministic content checks to required implementation elements; it does not execute arbitrary learner code. Do not include secrets or production credentials. A task is accepted only when its required elements are present.
